HOW TO ACCESS:
--------------
1. Open your browser and navigate to one of the URLs above
2. You'll get a security warning (self-signed certificate) - click "Advanced" and proceed
3. Select "Token" authentication method
4. Paste the admin token above
5. Click "Sign In"
